brief: The canvas displays a continuous pattern of concentric rings that expand outward from the center point. These rings appear to ripple as they expand, giving the illusion of expanding sound waves or ripples in water. The entire pattern is rendered using only a limited grayscale palette, varying between black, white, and shades of gray. The pattern is dynamic and moves continually on its own, without any required input from the viewer.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing ripple effect using concentric grayscale rings that emanate from the center of the canvas. Each ring expands outward at its own speed, creating a wave-like pattern reminiscent of water ripples or sound waves. The rings fade out as they expand, and their opacity varies to create depth and visual interest. The animation is entirely self-contained, requiring no user input to function, and the continuous motion ensures that the canvas changes visibly over time.
